User Handbook — v1

TaxFlow, screen by screen.

Every screen across the main business dashboard, the HRMS portal, and the Employee Self-Service portal — what it's for, and how to use it. Jump to any section from the contents on the left, or read straight through.

Main App 13 sections
HRMS 15 sections
Employee Self-Service 9 sections
Part One

Main App

The main business dashboard — sales, purchases, inventory, accounting, tax, and reporting. This is what a company admin sees day to day.

Overview
M.01

Dashboard

The dashboard is the first thing you see after signing in. Total Revenue, Total Purchases, and Net Profit update live from your actual invoices and bills — nothing here is a placeholder. The VAT Position card shows your current output VAT, input VAT, and net payable for the FTA period at a glance, and the Bank Reconciliation card flags whether your book balance matches your bank statement. A Workforce Snapshot row surfaces the same headline HR numbers you'd otherwise open HRMS to see — active headcount, present today, on leave, net payroll this month, open positions, pending approvals. If your company has more than one branch, Branch Performance breaks revenue and profit down per branch, with an Impersonate option to log in as that branch and see exactly what it sees. Use + New Invoice or + Add Purchase in the top-right to jump straight into recording a transaction without leaving the dashboard.

Sales
M.02

Sales & Invoices

Create, send, and track every invoice from one screen. The KPI row splits invoices into Total, Outstanding, Paid, and Overdue so you always know what's still owed. Click + New Invoice to build one line by line — VAT calculates automatically — and use the row actions to view, share by email or WhatsApp, or mark an invoice paid (which opens a pre-filled receipt so the payment is properly recorded, not just a status flip). You can also upload existing invoices and let AI extraction read the details for you instead of typing them in.

M.03

Quotations

Draft a price quote for a customer before committing to a full invoice. A quotation can be edited freely while it's pending, and once the customer accepts it, converts directly into a sales invoice — carrying over every line item, so nothing needs re-entering.

Purchasing
M.04

Purchases

Every bill you owe a supplier lives here, whether it was typed in manually or pulled from an uploaded document via AI extraction. The table shows net amount, VAT, and what's still due per bill. Purchases with stock-tracked items automatically update your inventory levels the moment they're saved — you don't need to adjust stock separately.

M.05

Inventory

Tracks what you actually have on hand, item by item, calculated from real purchase and sale movements rather than a manually maintained count. Use the mapping screen to connect a supplier's product name to your own internal item name and pricing rule (cost + markup, or a fixed price) — once mapped, every future purchase and sale recognizes that item automatically. Sales invoices now deduct tracked stock automatically, and cancelling one puts it back. The Adjustments tab handles cycle-count corrections and write-offs (stock only moves once an adjustment is approved) and has a Block sales when stock is insufficient checkbox — turn it on and any invoice or POS sale that would take an item below zero is refused.

M.06

Expenses

For day-to-day business costs that aren't a supplier bill — rent, subscriptions, fuel, office supplies. Categorize each expense as you log it so your Profit & Loss report breaks costs down meaningfully rather than lumping everything into one line.

Finance
M.07

Bank & Payments

Manage bank accounts, record customer receipts and supplier payments, and reconcile your books against a real bank statement. When you're allocating a payment across more than one invoice, typing a partial amount automatically splits it evenly across whichever invoices you've selected — capping any invoice at its own remaining balance and spreading the rest across the others, rather than leaving you to divide it up by hand. A recorded payment can be deleted if it was entered in error; deleting reverses the accounting entry and puts the invoice back to its real outstanding state. The reconciliation tool matches statement lines to your recorded transactions by amount, date, and reference, and clearly flags anything left unmatched so nothing slips through.

M.08

Accounting

The chart of accounts, journal entries, and general ledger behind every number in the app. Every invoice, bill, payment, and payroll run posts here automatically — you don't need to create journal entries by hand for normal transactions. Period locking prevents accidental changes to a month once it's closed.

M.09

Corporate Accounting

Covers the UAE Corporate Tax workbook (9% rate, AED 375,000 small-business threshold), fixed assets, accruals and prepayments, cost centers, budgets, and cash flow — the heavier accounting tools a growing company needs beyond day-to-day bookkeeping. Use Post Depreciation on a fixed asset to book the period's depreciation to the ledger (it can never exceed the asset's cost), and Post Release on an accrual or prepayment to book each period's release. The Cash Flow tab reads receipts and payments from the ledger.

Reports
M.10

Reports

Trial Balance, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, VAT 201, and Corporate Tax reports, all generated from your posted ledger rather than a separate summary someone has to keep in sync. Export the FTA VAT 201 directly as a filing-ready PDF. Profitability Analytics breaks results down by cost centre, department, and branch, alongside a real EBITDA figure (net profit with tax, interest, and depreciation/amortization added back) — not just a top-line P&L. CFO Recommendations surfaces the specific things worth your attention this period, ranked by priority, instead of leaving you to spot them yourself in the raw numbers.

Compliance
M.11

Notifications

A configurable alert center — get warned about upcoming document expiries, VAT return deadlines, and other compliance dates before they become a problem, not after.

M.12

AI Assistant

Ask a plain-language question about your own company's data — "what's my VAT position this quarter", "which invoices are overdue" — and get an answer grounded in your real, live figures, not a generic response.

Voice: click the microphone beside Send, speak your question, then click it again (it stops by itself after a pause in Chrome, Edge and Safari). Pick EN or عربي first; Arabic questions get Arabic answers. The answer is read aloud unless you turn the speaker off. Voice only asks questions — it never saves or posts anything.

Company
M.13

Settings

Company registration and TRN details, invoice design (logo, color, layout), sales categories and units of measure, departments and branches, and user access all live here. This is also where you enable additional business locations under Departments & Branches. Company admins can add colleagues under Users — each gets a real login with an Accountant, Viewer or User role.

Part Two

HRMS

A separate portal for everything people-related — employees, attendance, rota, leave, payroll, and recruitment. Opens on its own, with its own sidebar.

Getting there
H.00

Opening HRMS

HRMS is a separate portal from the main business dashboard, reached via HRMS under People & HR in the main sidebar (it opens in a new tab at /hrms), or directly if your login is an HR employee account rather than a company admin. It has its own sidebar, covering everything below.

Overview
H.01

Dashboard

Headcount, today's attendance, pending approvals, and a workforce attendance trend chart, all pulled from real records. Quick Actions in the sidebar jumps straight to the six things you'll do most — add an employee, add a task, run payroll, open the weekly rota, approve leave, or check attendance — without hunting through the sidebar. The Pending Approvals panel is the fastest way to see what's waiting on you — leave requests, OT requests, attendance corrections, loan requests — without opening each module separately.

People
H.02

Employees

The full employee directory — add a new employee, edit their department, designation, salary, and shift details, or deactivate someone who's left. Deactivating an employee keeps their full history intact everywhere (past payroll, attendance, leave) but removes them from every "assign to" list going forward, so you'll never accidentally schedule or pay someone who no longer works there.

H.03

Attendance

Today's Attendance shows who's checked in right now, with a date picker if you need to look at a previous day. The calendar below color-codes each day by attendance status — click any day for a full roll call. Use + Correction to fix a missed punch, Import CSV for bulk device data, and Sync Now to pull the latest punches from a connected biometric device. The 30-Day Attendance Trend chart shows headcount per day as a smooth area chart with today's, the average and the peak counts above it — hover any point for that day's number; weekends are shaded. Daily Check is a manual roll call for days without biometric data: everyone starts as Present and you tick the absentees.

Scheduling
H.04

Rota & Shift

Define shift templates (start/end time, break, grace period) under Shift Setup, then build the actual weekly or monthly schedule by assigning shifts to employees. Click an employee's name in the Weekly Rota to see their tasks for that week in one place, day by day. You can also attach one or more Task Management tasks directly to a shift when you edit it — they show up on that day's cell, on the Monthly Rota, and in the Excel/PDF export. Department Rota gives a coverage view by shift for one department at a time. Rota Approval routes a completed schedule through supervisor sign-off before it's published, and Swap Requests lets two employees trade a shift with HR approval.

People
H.05

Leave

Every leave request, its approval status, and each employee's real remaining balance for every leave type — not just Annual Leave. Approve or reject a request directly from the table; approving deducts from that employee's entitlement immediately, so the balance shown is always accurate for the next request. The Leave Calendar below gives a month-grid overview of every approved leave company-wide — a colored chip per employee on leave that day, so you can spot coverage gaps at a glance instead of scanning the table row by row.

Money
H.06

Payroll

Run payroll for a period and the system calculates each employee's basic salary, allowances, overtime, and deductions (loan/advance repayments included) automatically from their attendance and approved OT. Click Run Payroll once you're happy with the preview, then use WPS/SIF to generate the UAE bank salary file. Generating a run does not touch loan or advance balances — they are only reduced when you Approve the run. Draft runs can be deleted; future periods cannot be run. Bonus and overtime adjustments add to pay, deductions and advances subtract. The SIF file needs each employee's bank IBAN and your company's MOL id, and is built from the approved run. Employees see their payslip in ESS only after approval.

H.07

Overtime

Employees submit OT requests here (or HR enters one on their behalf), each calculated against the multiplier configured in HR Settings for normal, weekend, public holiday, and Ramadan hours. Approved OT flows straight into the next payroll run — nothing needs re-entering. At the top of the tab, Overtime Eligibility lists every day an employee worked past the standard day, straight from attendance: clock in, clock out, time worked, extra time, eligible overtime and a status — Eligible – not yet requested, Requested – Pending / Approved / Rejected, or Not eligible (within cool-off). Pick a date range and click Request OT on an eligible row to raise the request with the hours already filled in. The cool-off is set in HR Settings: the first N minutes after the standard day are not counted as overtime.

H.08

Loans & Advances

Employee loan requests with an EMI schedule that auto-deducts from payroll until the balance clears, plus one-off salary advances deducted from the next pay run. Approving a loan doesn't just change its status — it locks in the balance and EMI amount payroll will actually use.

Hiring & Growth
H.09

Recruitment (ATS)

Post a job requisition, track candidates through Screening → Interview → Offer → Hired, and move them along the pipeline as they progress. A hired candidate becomes the starting point for a new employee record.

H.10

Performance, Training & Assets

Three related tools on one page, shown here as they're designed to work: Performance as KPI-based reviews on a defined appraisal cycle (goal-setting → mid-year → self-assessment → manager appraisal), Training as completed programs per employee, and Asset Management as company equipment issued to staff and its return. Note: these three are still record-viewing only for now — the "+ Add" actions aren't wired up to actually save a new KPI, training record, or asset yet.

Operations
H.11

Task Management

A straightforward task list for assigning and tracking work items to employees, separate from formal HR workflows — each task has an assignee, a status, and a color you choose so it's easy to spot on the Rota. Use + Add Task to create one (with a color and, optionally, an assignee), or + Assign Task to hand an existing task to one or several employees at once by ticking them from a searchable list. A task with no assignee still shows up as "Unassigned" rather than disappearing.

Insight
H.12

Reports & Analytics

A per-employee attendance report for any month — present/absent/leave day counts and total hours at a glance. Click any employee's name to drill into their full day-by-day breakdown, including every clock-in/clock-out session, overtime, and under-time for that month.

H.13

AI Insights

HR-specific AI tools: parse a CV to prefill a new employee's onboarding form, scan payroll for anomalies, score attrition risk, run a UAE labour law compliance check, and ask a chatbot free-form questions about your workforce data.

Configuration
H.14

HR Settings

Everything that shapes how the rest of HRMS behaves: departments and branches, roles and their permissions, overtime rate rules, leave type entitlements, general HR rules (grace periods, weekend policy), the holiday calendar, and Users & Access — where you grant an employee a portal login and assign them a role. Under Overtime Rules, Cool-off before OT starts (minutes) sets how long after the standard day an employee must keep working before overtime begins to count (0 = off).

Part Three

Employee Self-Service

A self-service portal for employees themselves — each person sees only their own attendance, leave, rota, tasks, and payslips.

Getting there
E.00

Signing in

Employees sign in at /ess with their Employee ID or a custom username — the default password is their Employee ID until they change it. This is a separate, self-contained portal: an employee only ever sees their own records here, never anyone else's.

Overview
E.01

Dashboard

A personal summary the moment you log in: today's real attendance status (with the actual check-in time, not just "present"), leave pending count, remaining annual leave balance, next scheduled shift, open task count, and the latest payslip's net pay. A Quick Actions grid gives one-tap shortcuts to the requests you make most — apply for leave, request overtime or a salary advance, clock in/out, check the rota. A compact My Team Attendance card and your Latest Payslip sit below, and Pending With HR tracks every request type awaiting approval — leave, overtime, and attendance fixes — not just leave.

My Records
E.02

Attendance

Your own punch history for the last 90 days — date, time, direction (in/out), and how it was recorded. This mirrors exactly what HR sees for you, so there's never a discrepancy between what you see here and what payroll uses.

E.03

Leave

Leave Balance breaks down your remaining days per leave type (Annual, Sick, Emergency, Maternity, Paternity, Hajj, and more). File a new request with + Request Leave — pick a type, your dates, and an optional reason — and cancel a still-pending one yourself if plans change. The Holiday & Team Leave Calendar shows company holidays and which teammates are already off on any given day — click a day to request leave for it directly. Everything you file goes straight into HR's approval queue; no need to ask in person or over chat. A request is refused if it starts more than 30 days in the past or asks for more days than you have left (unpaid leave excepted). On the Requests tab, Overtime Eligibility lists the days you worked past your standard hours (last 31 days) with your clock in, clock out and whether the overtime is eligible or already requested — press Request to open the overtime form pre-filled.

E.04

Rota

Your own upcoming shifts for the next 30 days, each shown with its actual start and end time and location, plus any tasks a manager has attached to that shift — no need to check a printed schedule or ask a supervisor what you're on next. Switch to Department Rota to see your whole department's schedule for a given week, not just your own.

E.05

Tasks

Any task assigned to you from HRMS Task Management, with its priority and current status. This updates the moment HR or a manager assigns or moves something on their side — and you can update the status yourself too (start it, mark it done) as you work through it, so your progress shows up on the HR side without anyone having to chase you for an update.

E.06

Payslips

Every payslip from a completed payroll run, broken down into basic salary, allowances, overtime, and deductions, ending in your net pay for that period. A payslip appears only once HR has approved that payroll run.

Attendance tools
E.07

GPS Check-In

For companies using location-based attendance instead of (or alongside) a biometric device: check in or out from your phone, and the system verifies you're actually within the company's registered work location before accepting it.

Account
E.08

Profile

Your basic employment details (department, designation, status, working hours) shown read-only — set by HR, not editable here. Three things you can change yourself: your Contact Details (mobile, address, emergency contact — everything else on your record stays HR-controlled), your portal password, and nothing else. My Documents tracks your visa, passport, Emirates ID, and other document expiry dates once HR has added them, so you can see what's coming due at a glance.

TaxFlow Handbook — captured from the live application. Screens reflect real company data at the time of writing; your own figures will differ.
